notes: Both hash probe modes use the identical candidate benchmark source and statically link their respective release library. V1 is the superseded eager per-source adapter; v2 filters during ordered merge selection; v3 preserves ordinary iterator layouts. Exact run commands and binary hashes are in manifests.
historical_copy_caveat: Copied-image runs did not explicitly fsync the buffered copy before O_DIRECT warmup and timing. Pending writeback might overlap historical disk runs. Native hash probes create their own O_DIRECT databases.
